units.source_text: 那时，我万分恐惧，或者说，万分痛苦，反正是呆若木鸡了。

en.t: At that moment, I was utterly terrified, or rather in unbearable pain; in any case, I was frozen stiff.

units.source_text: 从头顶到脚底，我突然变得像石头或铁块那样坚硬了，坚硬得连呼吸的起伏都没有了。

en.t: From the top of my head to the soles of my feet, I suddenly became as hard as stone or iron, so rigid that even the rise and fall of breathing disappeared.

units.source_text: 幸而这种状态没有持续多久，瞬间之后，我又恢复了常态。

en.t: Fortunately, that state did not last long, and after an instant I returned to normal.

units.source_text: 这时我突然意识到，完了，被他抢在前头了。

en.t: Then I suddenly realized: it was over; he had beaten me to it.

units.source_text: 但是，我根本想不出以后该怎么办，大概也没有时间好好思考吧。

en.t: But I could not think at all what I should do next; perhaps there was no time to think it through properly.

units.source_text: 我忍受着腋下难闻的汗液湿透了衬衣，一动也没有动。

en.t: I endured the foul sweat under my arms soaking through my shirt and did not move at all.

units.source_text: 而在这段时间里，K仍然张开一如既往的沉重的嘴巴，断断续续地倾诉着自己的衷肠。

en.t: During that time, K still opened his heavy mouth as usual and haltingly poured out what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 我痛苦之极，我觉得自己那痛苦的表情，就像一大张文字清晰的广告贴在自己脸上似的。

en.t: I was in extreme anguish, and I felt that my agonized expression was like a huge advertisement with clear lettering pasted across my face.

units.source_text: K即便再不敏感也不会看不到，但他此时把所有的注意力都集中在自己的心事上了，所以无暇顾及我的表情吧。

en.t: Even K, however insensitive, could not have failed to see it, but at that moment all his attention was fixed on his own concerns, so he probably had no room to notice my face.

units.source_text: 他的告白从始至终贯穿着同样的语调，凝重而迟钝，给我一种不可轻易动摇的感觉。

en.t: His confession kept the same tone from beginning to end; it was grave and slow, and it gave me the feeling that it could not easily be shaken.

units.source_text: 我的心一半在听他告白，另一半却一直焦虑地反复想着，我该怎么办，

en.t: Half of my mind was listening to his confession, while the other half kept anxiously repeating, what should I do,

units.source_text: 所以细微之处几乎没有听进耳朵里去。

en.t: so the details scarcely entered my ears.

units.source_text: 不过，他倾诉时的语调却强烈震撼着我，

en.t: Even so, the tone in which he spoke shook me powerfully,

units.source_text: 我不但感受到上面所说的那样的痛苦，还感受到了某种恐惧。

en.t: I felt not only the pain I have described above, but also a certain fear.

units.source_text: 也就是说，对方比自己强，这一恐怖的念头在我心里萌生了。

en.t: In other words, the frightening thought that the other man was stronger than I was began to arise in my heart.
